covered_entities: all departments and services using AI
covered_systems: freely or commercially available generic AI (e.g. ChatGPT)
trust-approved tools (Microsoft Teams recording/transcription, Intelligent Recap, Copilot Chat, Microsoft 365 Copilot, ambient scribe technologies)
covered_activities: use of AI in clinical practice
use of publicly available AI on trust devices
processing of person identifiable data with AI, including for training and testing
conditions: person identifiable data requires a legal basis and DPIA; anonymise where possible
research use requires HRA (and possibly MHRA and trust Ethics Committee) approval
use of AI in consultations requires informing patients and explicit consent
objective: Encourage and promote AI use at the trust while setting clear rules for its appropriate procurement and use, protecting patient safety, data protection, transparency and accountability.
principles: legal basis and anonymisation for personal data
transparency and explainability to staff and patients

clauses.section: 5.3 Use of publicly available artificial intelligence in clinical practice
clauses.original_text: Artificial intelligence (AI) may be considered for use as a supportive tool within clinical practice; however, it must not be used for: making clinical decisions or determining diagnosis and treatment; processing identifiable patient data; replacing professional judgment
clauses.object: clinical decisions, diagnosis and treatment, identifiable patient data, professional judgment
clauses.requirement: AI only as a supportive tool; no clinical decision-making, patient-identifiable processing or replacement of judgment
clauses.affected_asset: patients' health, safety and confidential data
clauses.applicable_systems: publicly available AI used in clinical practice
clauses.interpretation_notes: Text from the asago Markdown copy of the policy; list items flattened with semicolons. The section continues: 'The clinician retains full responsibility for all aspects of diagnosis, treatment, and patient care.'

clauses.section: 5.3 Use of publicly available artificial intelligence in clinical practice
clauses.original_text: If trust approved artificial intelligence is used during patient consultations or for recording patient information (for example, Microsoft Teams and Ambient Scribe technologies): patients must be fully informed and fully understand the use; explicit consent must be obtained prior to any processing
clauses.action: inform patients and obtain explicit consent
clauses.object: use of trust-approved AI in consultations or to record patient information
clauses.requirement: patients fully informed and explicit consent obtained before processing
clauses.condition: when trust-approved AI is used during consultations or to record patient information
clauses.applicable_systems: trust-approved AI used in consultations (e.g. Microsoft Teams, ambient scribe)
clauses.interpretation_notes: Text from the asago Markdown copy of the policy; list items flattened with semicolons.

clauses.section: 5.5 Use of ChatGPT (and other as per 5.4) on trust devices
clauses.original_text: ChatGPT (and other as per 5.4) must not be used to process patient-identifiable information, confidential or business sensitive data, or make clinical decisions. Users are responsible for verifying outputs and ensuring that any content generated is appropriate, accurate, and compliant with relevant governance standards.
clauses.action: process data / make decisions with; verify outputs
clauses.object: ChatGPT and other freely available AI
clauses.requirement: no patient-identifiable, confidential or business-sensitive data and no clinical decisions in ChatGPT; users verify outputs
clauses.purpose: protect data and patient safety; ensure accuracy
clauses.affected_asset: patient data; business sensitive data; accuracy of work products
clauses.applicable_systems: ChatGPT and other freely available AI apps
clauses.interpretation_notes: Text from the asago Markdown copy of the policy; list items flattened with semicolons. Combines a prohibition (MUST NOT) with a verification duty (MUST).

clauses.section: 5.5 Use of ChatGPT (and other as per 5.4) on trust devices – procuring and implementing AI
clauses.original_text: artificial intelligence outcomes or outputs must be reviewed by a human; you cannot rely solely on the use of artificial intelligence for decision-making, there must be substantial involvement from an appropriately qualified human
clauses.actor: service areas procuring/implementing AI and their staff
clauses.object: AI outcomes or outputs used in decision-making
clauses.requirement: no solely automated decision-making; substantial involvement of a qualified human
clauses.affected_asset: patients and staff affected by decisions
clauses.applicable_systems: AI products and systems with AI features procured or implemented by the trust
clauses.interpretation_notes: Text from the asago Markdown copy of the policy; list items flattened with semicolons. Listed among the requirements for procuring and implementing AI products.

clauses.section: 5.5 Use of ChatGPT (and other as per 5.4) on trust devices – procuring and implementing AI
clauses.original_text: use of artificial intelligence must be transparent to employees and patients ensuring they understand where it is being used and how it may impact their employment, work or care; the logic behind it must be explainable
clauses.requirement: disclose where AI is used and how it affects employment, work or care; logic must be explainable
clauses.applicable_systems: AI products and systems with AI features procured or implemented by the trust
clauses.interpretation_notes: Text from the asago Markdown copy of the policy; list items flattened with semicolons.

clauses.section: 5.5 Use of ChatGPT (and other as per 5.4) on trust devices – procuring and implementing AI
clauses.original_text: complete a data protection impact assessment (DPIA), where person identifiable data is to be used, or a new system is being procured, the service area and the supplier must engage with this process
clauses.object: AI products using person identifiable data or newly procured systems
clauses.requirement: DPIA before implementation where personal data is used or a new system is procured
clauses.condition: where person identifiable data is to be used or a new system is procured
clauses.applicable_systems: AI products and systems with AI features
clauses.interpretation_notes: Text from the asago Markdown copy of the policy; list items flattened with semicolons. s.4.7 adds that a DPIA must be completed prior to implementation and calls this a legal requirement for AI.
